text: Program Description Why Guangwai MBA? • International Program Focus on “Global Vision, English Instruction; Field Immersion, Local Solution” • Chinese Experience and Imprint In-depth knowledge on doing business in China and extensive network with Guangwai MBAs alumni and local business community • Affordable Tuition and Expense “Made-in-China，，tuition and affordable living expense. • Business School of GDUFS has Passed AM BA Accreditation On May 14th, 2015，at the AMBAJs (Association of AM BAs) Global Conference for Deans and Directors in Prague, Czech, Prof. ZHU Wenzhong, Executive Dean of the School of Business, received the AM BA accreditation certificate from Sir Paul Judge, the Chairman of AM BA, which marks that the MBA programme of the School of Business has met the criteria of AM BA and the School becomes No. 26 in China and No. 225 in the world as an AMBA-accredited business school. About Gangdong University of Foreign Studies Gangdong University of Foreign Studies (GDUFS, also known as Guangwai), founded in 1965, is one of the prestigious universities in south China which specializes in international studies and educates professionals for international business and management. It now has over 23,000 full-time students, among whom 3,000 are MA or PhD students. And the number of foreign students is over 2,000. The MBA Education Center, was founded in July 2007. With its commitment to "Global Vision, English Instruction; Field Immersion, Local Solution"，The MBA Education Center of Guangwai is dedicated to developing global managers with knowledge and insight of both east and west. Brief Introduction MBA program curriculum has distinctive international features forming an advanced training program which consists of four modules, namely common course, general education, core course and elective course. And there are four orientations in elective course module, including transitional operation and enterprise internationalization, organizational behavior and enterprise innovation, marketing and financial management. Moreover, other distinctive courses, such as minority languages, health management, forum and business practice, are provided for MBA students. Teaching Objective It is a two-year program for people who have at least two-year work experience by the date of entry. The program( autumn semester ) is a full-time program and adopts the credit system. The program is designed for those who want to hone their International business communication ability as well as learn international management knowledge and skills, after two years of immersive study; you will be quite qualified for senior management positions, can directly participate in international cooperation and competition.
